channel.title: Ansumana Darboe | Blog
channel.description: Notes on React, performance, microservices, and building software that survives real users and real traffic.

item.title: Event-Driven Microservices: When Your App Gets Too Big
item.description: There was a time deploy took thirty seconds. Then the codebase grew, teams multiplied, and nobody wanted to touch production on a Friday.

item.title: React Hooks
item.description: Before hooks, you either wrote a simple function with no state or a class component with lifecycle methods and boilerplate.

item.title: Performance Optimization: When Your App Starts to Crawl
item.description: The app felt fast on your laptop. Then real users arrived on older phones and slow networks, and the complaints started.

item.title: The Virtual DOM: React's Secret to Speed
item.description: Updating the real DOM directly forces the browser to recalculate layout more than you need.

item.title: React Components, State, and Props: The Building Blocks
item.description: A React app is small pieces with one job each: a button handles clicks, a card shows a user, a list renders rows.

item.title: A Deep Dive into React
item.description: What started as a clean component sometimes becomes a five-hundred-line file that does everything.

item.title: Why I Chose React Over Angular or Vue
item.description: I built the same kinds of projects in React, Angular, and Vue. All three work.
